home.description: Discover the art of Goju Ryu Karate
home.heroTagline: The Hard and Soft Way of the Empty Hand
home.introText: Goju Ryu is one of the main traditional Okinawan styles of karate, featuring a combination of hard and soft techniques. Developed by Chojun Miyagi in the early 20th century, this martial art emphasizes both strength and fluidity in movement.
home.miyagiQuote: In karate, striking, thrusting, and kicking are not the only methods. Throwing techniques and pressure against joints are included.
